name: When is the best time of year to start a home remodel in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a home remodel in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start a home remodel in Orange County often depends on the type of project. For exterior work like additions or roofing, the drier months from late spring to early fall (May to October) are ideal. Interior remodels can be done year-round, but scheduling during off-peak times, such as late fall or winter, might offer more flexibility with contractor availability and potentially shorter lead times for materials. Consider your personal schedule and holiday seasons as well.
acceptedAnswer.description: For exterior work in Orange County, late spring to early fall is best. Interior remodels can be done year-round, with late fall or winter potentially offering more contractor availability.
